title: [BUG] Panel title is cut off when it contains emoji
body:
- [x] I've checked docs and closed issues for possible solutions.
- [x] I can't find my issue in the FAQ.

**Describe the bug**

A `Panel` whose title contains an emoji is truncated one cell early.

```python
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich import print
print(Panel('body', title='Status ✅ ok', width=20))
```
